Research Master's and PhDs
If you are interested in undertaking a Research Master's or PhD in UCD, detailed information on what is required and how to apply is available here
Before applying for the Research Masters/PhD online via the Admissions system, you must identify a supervisor.
The Civil Engineering academic staff information is available here.
Once you have identified one or two potential supervisors, email them to ask whether they are accepting new graduate research students for the coming academic year, and include:
your name
your academic background
your academic awards or highlights
your research experience
why you wish to enter doctoral studies
why the academic member of staff’s area of research will match with your research goals (cite the academic’s publications)
a research proposal, if appropriate.
All supervisors receive many applications from potential research students, so an email out of the blue is completely normal.
During discussions, a potential supervisor will ask to see supporting documents related to your academic history, language proficiency, etc.
Once accepted by a supervisor, you will be sent a closed link to the online admissions system, so you can submit your official application.
